From the d4fa file, keep rows with len(text) >= 6000 characters that either have loop_A false or have loop_A true with onset_A_char >= 7000; drop rows with loop_A true and onset_A_char missing or < 7000. Join each kept row by problem_index to the P_math500 row with sample == 0; drop rows with no such RL row. Score each kept row with d = the RL row's n_generated; RL cap hits keep their n_generated as stored. Statistic: AUROC of d as a score for loop_A == true (Mann-Whitney form, ties count 0.5). Report the number of kept rows and positives.
tests.note: Files: runs/theory-tests/duel-r4-m01/d4fa_answers.jsonl (modal volume iterate-runs abaybektursun-1114-151718-d4fa/answers.jsonl, 500 run_cell rows, base cue T0.6 top-p 1.0) and runs/theory-tests/duel-r4-m01/s2800_P_math500.jsonl (s3 .../r3/s2800-01/out/P_math500.jsonl, 500 rln3_gen rows, all sample 0). Filters as written: len(text) >= 6000 chars (text includes the cue opening), keep loop_A false, keep loop_A true only if onset_A_char is present and >= 7000; join by problem_index to the RL sample-0 row; d = RL n_generated as stored (cap hits not altered). AUROC = Mann-Whitney over all positive/negative pairs, d_pos > d_neg scores 1, ties 0.5 (higher d predicts loop). Kept rows, positives, negatives and RL cap hits are printed. Alt reading: d = RL n_new instead of n_generated (in the one RL row opened n_generated = n_new + 1 even with empty prefill, so alt should equal main unless the offset varies; it is a check rather than a substantive alternative — the recipe is otherwise unambiguous). If there are no positives or no negatives the script reports not_computable (AUROC undefined); the recipe does not say that case is refuted. RL cap hits stored at about 16,384 tie with each other and count 0.5 in pairs among themselves.

tests.experiment: Does early compressibility still predict a rule-A loop once problems are matched on difficulty (AUROC computed within quartiles of RL answer length)?
tests.recipe: Files iterate-runs:abaybektursun-1114-151718-d4fa/answers.jsonl and s3://pg-lineage-769063704696/results/rlneurons/r3/s2800-01/out/P_math500.jsonl. From d4fa, keep rows with len(text) >= 6000 characters that either have loop_A false or have loop_A true with onset_A_char >= 7000 (drop loop_A true with onset_A_char missing or < 7000). Join each kept row by problem_index to the P_math500 row with sample == 0; drop rows with no such RL row. For each kept row compute s = len(zlib.compress(text[:6000].encode('utf-8'), 9)) / len(text[:6000].encode('utf-8')) and d = the RL row's n_generated. Compute q1, q2, q3 = numpy.percentile(d over kept rows, [25, 50, 75]) (default linear interpolation). Stratum 1 = d <= q1, 2 = q1 < d <= q2, 3 = q2 < d <= q3, 4 = d > q3. Within each stratum, form every pair of one row with loop_A true and one row with loop_A false; a pair scores 1 if s_pos < s_neg, 0.5 if they are equal, else 0. Statistic: total score over all within-stratum pairs divided by the total number of within-stratum pairs (a stratum with no positives or no negatives contributes nothing). Report the number of pairs and positives per stratum.
tests.note: Files: same as k=2 (d4fa answers.jsonl and s2800 P_math500.jsonl in runs/theory-tests/duel-r4-m01/). Same row filters and join as k=2. s = len(zlib.compress(text[:6000].encode('utf-8'), 9)) / len(text[:6000].encode('utf-8')) on the stored text (which begins with the cue opening); d = RL n_generated. q1,q2,q3 = numpy.percentile(d over kept rows, [25,50,75]) linear; strata d<=q1, q1<d<=q2, q2<d<=q3, d>q3 (ties in d, e.g. RL cap hits, all land in the same stratum, so strata can be unequal in size). Main statistic: pooled within-stratum pairs, pair scores 1 if s_pos < s_neg, 0.5 if equal; total score / total pairs; per-stratum rows, positives, negatives, pairs and AUC printed. Alt reading: unweighted mean of the per-stratum AUROCs over strata with both classes. If no within-stratum pairs exist the script reports not_computable.
